<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Permission">
  <rdfs:comment>A right or allowance granted within a policy.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Permission</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ03, CQ06, CQ24 ask about permissions and their types/roles</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Shall the permissions 'Aggregation' and 'Disaggregation' be of the type Transfer Rights?
    (competency_question) CQ06: Expressing the various roles of contract parties within the Permission/Duty element.
    (competency_question) CQ24: How to express exclusive permissions?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#TransferRight"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf TransferRight -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#TransferRight">
  <rdfs:comment>A right that can be transferred or assigned.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Transfer Right</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ03 defines Permission as a subclass of TransferRight</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Shall the permissions 'Aggregation' and 'Disaggregation' be of the type Transfer Rights?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Role">
  <rdfs:comment>A function or capacity assigned to a contract party.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Role</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 models roles of contract parties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Expressing the various roles of contract parties within the Permission/Duty element.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#ContractParty">
  <rdfs:comment>An entity involved in a contractual agreement.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Contract Party</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06, CQ10 involve contract parties and their roles/rights</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Expressing the various roles of contract parties within the Permission/Duty element.
    (competency_question) CQ10: How are rights and duties supported for all contract parties?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Duty">
  <rdfs:comment>An obligation or requirement imposed on a party.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Duty</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06, CQ10, New CQ3, New CQ5 model duties and their relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Expressing the various roles of contract parties within the Permission/Duty element.
    (competency_question) CQ10: How are rights and duties supported for all contract parties?
    (competency_question) New CQ3: What duty is specified as a remedy for the violation of a prohibition?
    (competency_question) New CQ5: What duty is specified as a consequence of another duty?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Expression">
  <rdfs:comment>A logical or syntactic construct used in policies.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Expression</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 defines Operator as a subclass of Expression</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: How to provide a 'NOT' expression?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Operator">
  <rdfs:comment>A logical operator used in expressions or constraints.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Operator</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08, New CQ6 involve operators and their usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: How to provide a 'NOT' expression?
    (competency_question) New CQ6: What operator is used in the constraints of a prohibition?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Expression"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Expression -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Right">
  <rdfs:comment>An entitlement or privilege granted to a party.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Right</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ10 models rights supported for contract parties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ10: How are rights and duties supported for all contract parties?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Constraint">
  <rdfs:comment>A condition or limitation applied to requirements, permissions, or prohibitions.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Constraint</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ13, CQ14, CQ21, CQ26, New CQ6 model constraints and their nesting/operators</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ13: Shall ODRLv2 allow for nested constraints?
    (competency_question) CQ14: How do we express 'and', 'or', 'xor' constraints?
    (competency_question) CQ21: How to express constraints on requirements?
    (competency_question) CQ26: How to express Condition via Constraints?
    (competency_question) New CQ6: What operator is used in the constraints of a prohibition?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#LogicalOperator">
  <rdfs:comment>An operator that combines constraints logically.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Logical Operator</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 models logical operators for constraints</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: How do we express 'and', 'or', 'xor' constraints?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Requirement">
  <rdfs:comment>A mandatory condition or action in a policy.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Requirement</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 models constraints on requirements</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: How to express constraints on requirements?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#PolicyType">
  <rdfs:comment>A classification of a policy or permission.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Policy Type</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ24 models types of permissions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ24: How to express exclusive permissions?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Condition">
  <rdfs:comment>A prerequisite or situational factor for a policy rule.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Condition</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ26 models conditions expressed via constraints</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ26: How to express Condition via Constraints?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Container">
  <rdfs:comment>An entity that can contain other containers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Container</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ30 models container containment</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ30: What do we lose if containers are no longer part of ODRL?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Rule">
  <rdfs:comment>A policy directive that can contain actions or trigger other rules.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Rule</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ31, New CQ4 model rules and their activation/failure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ31: Do we need 'Sequencing' as part of the REL?
    (competency_question) New CQ4: Which rule is activated upon the failure of another rule?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Action">
  <rdfs:comment>An operation or behavior specified in a rule.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Action</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ31 models actions as part of rules</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ31: Do we need 'Sequencing' as part of the REL?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Class">
  <rdfs:comment>A conceptual category in the data model.</rdfs:comment>
